capsules.sql:
CREATE TABLE capsules (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, binding TEXT NOT NULL,
              payload BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_profiles.sql:
CREATE TABLE desk_profiles (
 tenant TEXT, id TEXT, version INTEGER, payload BLOB, digest TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(tenant,id,version))

desk_session_contexts.sql:
CREATE TABLE desk_session_contexts (
 tenant TEXT, session_id TEXT, version INTEGER, desk_id TEXT, payload BLOB, digest TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(tenant,session_id,version))

desk_session_repos.sql:
CREATE TABLE desk_session_repos (
 tenant TEXT, session_id TEXT, version INTEGER, repo TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(tenant,session_id,version,repo))

episodes.sql:
CREATE TABLE episodes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, binding TEXT NOT NULL,
              session TEXT NOT NULL, source_ref TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL,
              UNIQUE(binding, session, source_ref))

session_claims.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_claims (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL)

session_episodes.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_episodes (
 episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL)

source_episodes.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_episodes (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_ref TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE(session_id, source_ref))

source_projects.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_projects (
 session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repo_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence BLOB NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL)

source_sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_sessions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL)
